title: Entitled Walmart Worker Arrested For Stealing From Cash Register
description:
On November 24th, 2023, officers responded to an ongoing theft. A Walmart cashier had been stealing money from the cash register for a while. The woman vehemently denied stealing from the cash register and began to argue. The female remained very uncooperative. The female was transferred to jail for further processing. The female was charged with theft, resisting arrest and aggravated assault.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
